incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-service p99 latency > 3.0s across us-west (pager triggered) — count: 23 in last 5m. See dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/embeddings-latency :rotating_light:
ana (oncall): I'm on it - pulling logs and trace links now.
ana (oncall): preliminary: KV cache misses spiked, looks correlated with a redeploy ~10:10 UTC.
mike (sre): can you post the deploy id? if it's that, we can revert.
nana (oncall): deploy id: deploy-2026-04-01-3f2a. rolling back one revision now.
incident-bot: deploy-rollback job started by ana (oncall) — ETA ~2m.
nana (oncall): rollback succeeded, traffic back to previous revision. latency trending down but still some p99 blips.
javier (prodops): customer impact? any 500s or user-facing errors reported?
nana (oncall): no 5xx spikes in SLO panel, just high tail latency for embeddings calls affecting realtime scoring. A few customers saw slower responses.
shreya (eng): can we temporarily widen the alert threshold and add a quick squelch so we don't page for the next 10m while we watch?
mike (sre): yes - set alert to warning for 10m and disable paging rule on that alert. doing it now.
mike (sre): `alert: EmbeddingsP99High
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(embedding_request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 3.0
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning`
nana (oncall): thanks. leaving a note in runbook -> section "tail-latency: redeploy regressions" with links to traces.
nana (oncall): adding dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/embeddings-latency?from=2101234000&to=2101234800
ana (oncall): @mike i'm about to hand off to you in 20m. will leave a checklist in this thread and update runbook ownership.
mike (sre): good handoff. i'll watch the post-rollback period and drive any follow-up. please add an owner for tuning follow-ups.
shreya (eng): i'll take the tuning work: propose new alert thresholds + a dashboard tile for cache-miss rate and a short-term autoscale tweak.
shreya (eng): suggested changes (to be PR'd):
```
# increase p99 threshold for paging to 4s, add cache_miss ratio alert
- alert: EmbeddingsP99Page
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(embedding_request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 4.0
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
- alert: EmbeddingsCacheMissHigh
  expr: sum(rate(embedding_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(embedding_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
javier (prodops): please also add a short runbook snippet to explain acceptable transient blips and when to escalate to product. customers care about availability and SLA language matters.
nana (oncall): I've created a short post-incident checklist in runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings-tail-latency. Added owners: shreya (tuning), mike (monitoring), ana (postmortem).
mike (sre): created a monitoring dashboard PR that adds cache-miss panel + per-model p99 heatmap. link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/prs/1245
shreya (eng): I'll open the alert tuning PR after lunch and include test alerts in staging. tagging @ana for review.
nana (oncall): customer impact assessment: no user-facing 5xx, some degraded UX for ~15% of requests to realtime scoring for ~12 minutes. flagged for CSM outreach if any customers raise issues.
javier (prodops): filing a customer outreach flag: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENGOPS-6621 — pls add details.
nana (oncall): handing off now to @mike (sre). notes: rollback successful, watch for recurrence, watch cache-miss panel, follow-up owners assigned.
mike (sre): ack handoff. i'll keep this thread open for updates.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: embeddings-tail-latency — post-rollback monitoring period started by mike (sre). next check @ 2101234890.
mike (sre): follow-ups: 1) merge dashboard PR 1245, 2) review alert noise windows (add quiet-hours for low-traffic models), 3) add runbook annotation with deploy-id guardrails. I'll own 1+2.
shreya (eng): I'll take 3 and add a short helper script to include deploy id in trace links.
nana (oncall): created the retro ticket and included everyone: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENGOPS-6622 — brief: investigate root cause of cache miss spike, consider KV warmup, adjust autoscale.
mike (sre): closing this pager thread as mitigated. leaving runbook link again: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings-tail-latency — updated at 2101234720.
nana (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: if we see recurrence i'll re-page.
shreya (eng): adding a short note for runbook: include the exact alert snippets above and a pointer to the new dashboard tile.
mike (sre): last: created a tiny automation to squelch repeat pages during rollback windows — PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/alert-squelch/pull/89
incident-bot: THREAD SUMMARY: mitigated by rollback, monitoring period started, owners assigned (shreya/mike/ana), follow-ups tracked in ENGOPS-6621 & ENGOPS-6622.
